operation_details.item: The user always staffs engagements with only junior analysts and no subject-matter experts or partners regardless of client complexity.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy, but manageable. I’m shaping the team for a new operations improvement engagement.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds interesting. Are you thinking about bringing in a partner or a subject-matter specialist for the more complex parts?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not usually. I always staff engagements with only junior analysts, even when the client problem is complex.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a distinctive approach. How do you handle areas where the team lacks specialized experience?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We learn as we go and keep the team lean. I don’t add subject-matter experts or partners regardless of the engagement.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. I imagine that gives the analysts a lot of ownership, though it probably requires careful coaching and review.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I prefer practical collaboration over a heavily layered consulting structure.
